question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution encourages the protection and improvement of the environment, as well as the safeguarding of forests and wildlife?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 48A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 48A** of the Indian Constitution is part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**, which guides the state in formulating policies for the welfare of its citizens.
 
• This article explicitly emphasizes the need for the **protection and improvement of the environment** and the safeguarding of **forests and wildlife**.
 
• It was introduced by the **42nd Amendment Act of 1976**, which expanded the scope of environmental protection in India.
 
• The article directs the state to take proactive measures to preserve and improve the environment, ensuring a balance between development and ecological sustainability.
 
• Article 48A complements **Article 51A(g)**, which imposes a duty on citizens to protect the environment and have compassion for living creatures.
 
• This provision is vital in the context of India’s growing industrialization and urbanization, which have led to significant **environmental challenges**, including deforestation, pollution, and loss of biodiversity.
 
• Article 48A has inspired numerous laws and regulations in India, such as the **Wildlife Protection Act**, **Forest Conservation Act**, and **Environment Protection Act**, aimed at safeguarding natural resources.
